# Diagnose failed production DB credential rotation without reading or printing credentials.
---
TYPE: WORKFLOW_DISPATCH
COMMAND_ID: cmd-20260908-092000-prod-credential-rotation-diagnostic-v2
STATUS: PENDING
WORKFLOW: remote-operator.yml
REF: main
TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 10
INPUTS_JSON: {"operation":"command","mode":"sync","timeout_minutes":"10","workdir":"/opt/madworld","command":"set -euo pipefail; echo ROTATION_DIAG_START; echo deployed_sha=$(cat .github-deployed-sha); echo env_keys=$(awk -F= '/^(POSTGRES_USER|POSTGRES_DB|MADWORLD_DATABASE_URL)=/{print $1}' .env | paste -sd, -); echo db_url_present=$(grep -q '^MADWORLD_DATABASE_URL=' .env && echo yes || echo no); echo db_user_present=$(grep -q '^POSTGRES_USER=' .env && echo yes || echo no); echo db_name_present=$(grep -q '^POSTGRES_DB=' .env && echo yes || echo no); echo postgres_container=$(docker inspect madworld-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Status}} {{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null || echo missing); echo disk=$(df -Pm /opt/madworld | awk 'NR==2{print $4"MB_free"}'); echo backup_log_tail; tail -n 20 backups/backup.log 2>/dev/null || echo no-backup-log; echo backup_files=$(find backups -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'madworld-*.dump' | wc -l); echo db_probe; docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U postgres -Atqc \"SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datistemplate=false ORDER BY datname;\"; echo ROTATION_DIAG_DONE"}
---
